title: Sales & Marketing Executive
description:
**About Rayvolt Energy**

Rayvolt Energy is an Australian clean-energy company providing sustainable energy solutions, including solar panel installations, battery storage systems, air conditioning and heat pump solutions.

We are expanding our team and looking for motivated, enthusiastic and results-driven Sales & Marketing Executives in India to support our growing business in Australia.

If you have excellent communication skills, enjoy interacting with customers and are passionate about sales and marketing, this is an opportunity to develop your career in the growing renewable energy industry.

Key Responsibilities

**1. Lead Generation and Customer Engagement**

* Generate new business leads through online research, digital platforms, social media and other channels.
* Contact potential customers, understand their requirements and arrange follow-up discussions.
* Make outbound calls to prospective customers and respond to incoming enquiries.
* Maintain regular communication with leads and prospective customers.

**2. Sales and Business Development**

* Promote Rayvolt Energy's solar panel, battery storage, air conditioning and heat pump solutions.
* Understand customer requirements and coordinate with the sales team to identify suitable solutions.
* Follow up on quotations, enquiries and prospective sales opportunities.
* Work towards individual and team sales targets.
* Build strong customer relationships and contribute to business growth.

**3. Digital Marketing Support** — **Added Advantage**

* Assist with social media marketing campaigns and promotional activities.
* Support online lead-generation campaigns through platforms such as Facebook, Instagram and Google.
* Help identify new marketing opportunities and potential customer segments.
* Coordinate marketing content and promotional activities to improve brand awareness and generate enquiries.

**4. Customer Relationship Management and Reporting**

* Maintain accurate customer and lead information in the company's CRM system.
* Track enquiries, follow-ups, appointments and sales opportunities.
* Prepare regular reports on lead generation, customer engagement and sales performance.
* Work closely with the Australian team to improve lead conversion and customer experience.

Skills and Qualifications

**Essential requirements**

* Excellent verbal and written communication skills in English.
* Good interpersonal skills and the ability to communicate professionally with customers.
* A proactive, self-motivated and target-oriented approach.
* Basic computer skills, including Microsoft Excel, email and internet research.
* Ability to manage time effectively and work independently in a remote environment.
* Willingness to make outbound calls and follow up with prospective customers.

**Preferred qualifications**

* Experience in sales, telemarketing, lead generation, customer service or digital marketing.
* Knowledge of Facebook, Instagram, Google Ads or other digital marketing platforms.
* Experience using CRM systems and maintaining customer databases.
* Previous experience in solar energy, renewable energy, electrical products or related industries.

*Candidates without renewable energy experience are welcome to apply if they have the right communication skills, attitude and willingness to learn.*

What We Offer

* Opportunity to work remotely with an Australian clean-energy company.
* Exposure to the growing Australian solar and renewable energy market.
* Training and guidance on solar, battery storage and other energy solutions.
* Supportive team environment and opportunities for career development.
* Performance-based incentives and bonuses, subject to the company's compensation policy.
* Opportunity to develop sales, customer relationship management and digital marketing skills.

Working Hours

The role involves supporting customers and business operations in Australia. Candidates must be comfortable working hours that align with the Australian team's operating schedule.

Specific working hours and the applicable Australian time zone will be communicated during the recruitment process.

How to Apply

If you are confident speaking with customers, enjoy sales conversations and want to build a career with an Australian clean-energy company, we encourage you to apply.

Please submit your updated resume through Indeed. **You can also email your resume directly to us at support@rayvolt.com.au.**

**Your energy. Our future.**

Pay: ₹15,000.00 - ₹75,000.00 per month

Benefits:

* Work from home

title: I&P-GN - SONG-MT-DSMS-Customer Lifecycle Campaign- Retail-Manager
description:
**Job Summary:**

The I&P Global Network Song practice works with clients across their marketing, sales and services functions, providing transformation services driven by key offerings like Living Marketing, Connected Commerce and Next-Generation Customer Care. You will own customer lifecycle engagement and campaign transformation workstreams for clients across Retail, Financial Services, Software & Platforms, and Life Sciences. This is a workstream ownership role: you carry the client relationship for your track, lead a team of consultants, and are accountable for the commercial outcomes of the campaigns and journeys you design. You translate growth, retention and loyalty ambitions into segmented, decisioning-driven lifecycle interventions and prove the value they create.

**Roles & Responsibilities:**

* **Customer Lifecycle Strategy:**
* Own the end-to-end customer lifecycle framework - acquisition, onboarding, activation, engagement, cross-sell, upsell, retention, loyalty, renewal and win-back.
* Define customer segmentation and treatment strategies across lifecycle stage, value tier, behavioural profile, propensity, risk and engagement level.
* Own the campaign calendar and prioritisation across a complex, multi-channel environment, balancing commercial objectives, customer relevance, contact policy and regulatory requirements.
* **Next Best Action & Personalisation:**
* Translate business objectives into Next Best Action and Next Best Offer strategies - eligibility, suitability, applicability and prioritisation logic.
* Work with decisioning, data and martech teams to define engagement policies, arbitration rules, contact policy and suppression frameworks.
* Drive the shift from batch campaign execution to trigger-based, event-driven, real-time and always-on engagement.
* **Industry-Specific Growth & Retention Programmes:**
* Retail: Design lifecycle programmes that drive repeat purchase, purchase frequency, basket growth, loyalty participation, category expansion, omnichannel conversion and customer retention.
* Financial Services: Design onboarding, activation, product adoption, cross-sell, wallet-share, servicing, retention and lifetime-value programmes while accounting for consent, suitability and regulatory controls.
* Software & Platforms: Drive onboarding completion, feature adoption, free-to-paid conversion, usage expansion, subscription renewal, churn prevention and reactivation across user and account lifecycles.
* Life Sciences: Shape compliant HCP and patient engagement journeys, including HCP education, patient support programme enrolment, adherence, persistence and omnichannel engagement, in partnership with medical, legal and regulatory stakeholders.
* **Journey & Channel Orchestration:**
* Design omnichannel journeys across email, SMS, mobile app, push notifications, web, ecommerce, digital media, contact centre, sales and assisted channels.
* Translate customer behaviours, transactions and business events into automated lifecycle journeys and timely interventions.
* Optimise channel mix, cadence, content relevance and customer experience across touchpoints.
* **Generative AI in Customer Engagement:**
* Identify and land GenAI use cases across campaign planning, brief development, audience intelligence, content generation, personalisation and performance summarisation.
* Define quality, brand, compliance and human-review guardrails for AI-generated customer communication, with controls appropriate to regulated industries.
* **Measurement & Optimisation:**
* Own lifecycle performance measurement across acquisition, activation, engagement, conversion, retention, loyalty, renewal and customer lifetime value.
* Lead the test-and-learn agenda - control group design, A/B and multivariate testing, and incremental value attribution.
* Present performance read-outs and optimisation recommendations to client marketing and business leadership.
* **Team & Delivery Management:**
* Lead and coach a team of consultants and analysts; review and sign off on campaign strategy, journey design, build quality and reporting.
* Manage workstream plans, dependencies, risks and client expectations across marketing, sales, service, data, technology and compliance stakeholders.
* **Business Development Support:**
* Contribute to business cases, solution shaping and proposals; build reusable lifecycle marketing assets, accelerators and industry playbooks.

  

**Professional & Technical Skills:**

* **Customer Lifecycle Management and CRM experience** - ownership of lifecycle strategy, segmentation, campaign management, retention, loyalty, cross-sell and customer value programmes.
* **Relevant industry experience** across Retail, Financial Services, Software & Platforms and/or Life Sciences, with an understanding of the customer journeys, commercial levers and regulatory considerations relevant to the industry.
* **Working experience with campaign, journey and decisioning platforms** such as Pega Customer Decision Hub, Adobe Journey Optimizer / Adobe Experience Platform, Salesforce Marketing Cloud, Braze, Unica or equivalent - able to brief, review and challenge platform configuration.
* **Marketing automation and journey design** - designing trigger-based, event-driven and real-time journeys across digital and assisted channels.
* **Analytical rigour** - comfortable with segmentation, propensity models, cohort analysis, control group design and incremental value measurement; able to work directly with data and analytics teams.
* **Consulting experience** providing strategic advice and solutions to organisations, with strong structuring and storytelling ability.
* **Project management skills** - the ability to plan, execute and oversee a workstream so it is completed on time, within budget and meeting the specified goals.
* **People management** - experience leading, coaching and developing small delivery teams.
* **Good to have:** exposure to Generative AI or AI implementation within a marketing, campaign, personalisation or customer engagement transformation.
* **Additional skills:**
* Excellent oral and written communication skills.
* Proven success in navigating global matrixed environments and experience in client-facing roles.
* Ability to work effectively in a remote, virtual, fast-paced and unstructured global environment.

**Additional Information:**

**Your experience counts!**

* MBA from a tier 1 institute.
* Overall experience of 10+ years, with at least:
* 6+ years in CRM, customer lifecycle management, campaign management, marketing automation or marketing transformation - in consulting and/or an industry marketing function.
* 4+ years of relevant industry experience across Retail, Financial Services, Software & Platforms and/or Life Sciences, with direct ownership of customer growth, engagement, retention, loyalty or renewal outcomes.
* 2+ years managing a team or workstream.
* Good to have: hands-on project experience with GenAI, AI-powered personalisation or customer engagement transformation.

title: Integrated Marketing Program Manager
description:
Candescent is a forward-thinking technology company transforming how financial institutions deliver Intelligent Banking experiences. We unite digital banking, account opening, and branch solutions that power and connect digital banking, account opening, and branch solutions—creating seamless engagement across digital, remote, and in-person channels.

Our Experience-Led, Intelligence-Driven approach combines human-centered design with data, automation, and cloud-based innovation. Built on an API-first architecture, our extensible ecosystem enables institutions to adapt quickly, integrate easily, and unlock new opportunities for growth—turning every customer interaction into a moment of clarity, confidence, and connection.

***Role Purpose***

Candescent is seeking a Integrated Marketing Program Manager to connect our go-to-market strategy to rigorous execution on the ground. Based in one of our India office locations, you will own the delivery of marketing’s most important and most complex programs — the integrated campaigns, launches, and go-to-market initiatives that build brand visibility, generate pipeline, and support company growth.

This is a senior individual contributor role with real influence. You will be marketing leadership’s trusted planning partner — turning priorities into operating cadences, decision-ready materials, and clear owners, milestones, and outcomes. The integrated marketing calendar is a key tool in this, bridging strategy and execution by connecting agreed priorities to the work actually in flight.

Beyond delivering programs yourself, you will build the program management capability that marketing runs on. You will establish the standards, tools, and best practices that other teams adopt, and serve as the lead practitioner and mentor for a small group of coordination and project management professionals working across marketing operations, brand and communications, and digital.

The role carries high visibility. You will work directly with the Chief Marketing Officer and marketing senior leadership, and engage periodically with the Chief Revenue Officer and leaders across the revenue organization. It is an opportunity to shape how marketing executes, and to directly influence whether our go-to-market goals are met.

**Key Responsibilities and Deliverables**

*What you will be responsible for and what you will do*

**Program Planning & Delivery**

* Personally own end-to-end delivery of marketing’s largest and most complex cross-functional programs, from intake and planning through launch, measurement, and optimization.
* Translate go-to-market and marketing priorities into integrated roadmaps, milestone plans, dependency maps, and risk registers.
* Co-own execution alongside functional leads, partnering with product marketing on launches, brand on creative delivery, and demand generation on campaign activation.
* Ensure campaign briefs, objectives, audience definitions, content requirements, channel plans, measurement plans, and launch criteria are agreed before work enters execution.
* Manage portfolio-level visibility across concurrent programs, including prioritization, capacity trade-offs, escalation, and delivery risk mitigation.
* Own the integrated marketing calendar as the shared view of what marketing is delivering and when, using it to drive sequencing, prioritization, and capacity conversations.

**Center of Excellence & Practice Leadership**

* Establish and run a center of excellence for program and project management across marketing, raising the rigor, consistency, and maturity of how work is coordinated and delivered.
* Build the foundational toolkit other teams use to run their own work, including intake models, briefing standards, project templates, milestone and dependency frameworks, risk and status reporting formats, and launch checklists.
* Define and socialize standards and best practices for marketing execution, and help teams adopt them in a way that improves speed and quality rather than adding process for its own sake.
* Serve as the lead practitioner and mentor for coordination and project management professionals across marketing operations, brand and communications, and digital, creating a strong nucleus of shared standards and common ways of working across teams that do not share a reporting line.
* Coach these colleagues on planning discipline, stakeholder management, risk management, and executive communication; this role leads through influence and does not carry direct people management responsibility.
* Drive measurable improvement in effectiveness, consistency, efficiency, risk mitigation, and return on marketing investment, building capability that outlasts any one individual.

**Operating Cadence & Governance**

* Build and run the operating cadences that keep priorities, risks, dependencies, and next steps visible, including status reviews, planning cycles, and launch readiness forums.
* Help define how marketing operates together — establishing the operating model, rituals, and ways of working that scale as the team and its remit grow.
* Improve intake, prioritization, approval, and launch governance processes across marketing.
* Facilitate senior stakeholder alignment, ensuring decisions, scope changes, approvals, and dependencies are documented, communicated, and resolved.
* Keep planning tools and the marketing calendar current and trusted, so conflicts, gaps, and over-commitment surface before they affect delivery.
* Coordinate closely with the US-based Marketing Operations lead and the US-based process and program management counterpart to keep priorities aligned and standards consistent across regions.
* Apply AI tools practically to accelerate briefs, status reporting, documentation, and synthesis, and help the team adopt them in day-to-day ways of working.
* Maintain a working schedule with sufficient overlap with US business hours on at least a few days each week to enable live collaboration, reviews, and decision-making.

**Executive Engagement & Reporting**

* Partner directly with the Chief Marketing Officer and marketing senior leadership on planning, prioritization, and trade-off decisions, bringing forward the information they need to decide.
* Engage periodically with the Chief Revenue Officer and revenue organization leaders to align marketing execution with sales and pipeline priorities.
* Synthesize inputs from marketing, sales, product, and agency stakeholders into decision-ready briefings and reporting for leadership.
* Provide executive-ready visibility into program health, launch readiness, risks, blockers, trade-offs, and decisions required.
* Communicate clearly and concisely with senior leaders, simplifying complex workstreams and presenting trade-offs rather than escalating problems without options.

**Experience**

*Demonstrated skills, competencies, and required experience*

* 10+ years of experience in marketing program or project management, integrated campaign delivery, or marketing operations, including significant time at a senior level.
* Proven track record personally managing complex, high-visibility, multi-channel marketing programs in a fast-paced B2B environment, working directly with senior marketing leadership.
* Demonstrated ability to lead cross-functional teams, influence senior stakeholders, and drive accountability across functions without direct authority.
* Experience establishing program management standards, tools, or practices that other teams adopted, and mentoring other project or program management professionals.
* Strong working knowledge of how marketing moves from brief to content creation, channel activation, launch, and performance reporting.
* Practical fluency across core marketing channels, including email, web, webinars, events, paid media, organic social, and ABM programs.
* Experience running an integrated marketing calendar or equivalent planning system across multiple teams and channels.
* Excellent executive communication skills, with the ability to simplify complexity, present trade-offs, and escalate risks with recommendations.
* Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Business, Communications, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience.

**Qualifications & Preferred Distinctions**

*Additional accomplishments*

* PMP, agile, or equivalent program management certification is preferred.
* Experience in technology, financial services, SaaS, or other complex enterprise go-to-market environments is preferred.
* Experience with marketing automation, CRM, and work management platforms such as Marketo, Salesforce, Smartsheet, Jira, Asana, or Workfront.
* Experience leading ABM or account-focused programs, including target account prioritization, sales alignment, and account-level performance tracking.
* Experience managing external agencies, media partners, freelancers, or offshore and shared-services delivery teams.
* Working knowledge of campaign measurement, including engagement and conversion metrics, pipeline influence, attribution, and funnel movement.
* Experience building a new team, function, or delivery model from the ground up is a strong plus.

Experience collaborating across geographies and time zones is helpful.

title: Manager II, Science, Tech - Science

description:
At Columbia, we’re as passionate about the outdoors as you are. And while our gear is available worldwide, we’re proud to be based in the Pacific Northwest, where natural wonders are our playground.

And we believe in you.

  

**ABOUT THE POSITION**

Although we're an apparel and footwear-focused company, technology is central to everything we do. Columbia Sportswear’s Digital Technology (CDT) group enables an IT infrastructure and applications across four global brands, a global supply chain, and 500+ geographically dispersed stores. These teams support in-store, mobile, and data platforms to enhance customer interface and service in an ever-evolving industry.

The Quality Analyst II has a solid understanding of technology platforms and utilizes best practices among the quality team. This person reviews test strategies, authors test plans, and authors and executes test cases. The Quality Analyst II uses a variety of testing tools and methods and updates or creates automated test cases. The role executes automated test scripts and identify process and/ technology issues.

  

**HOW YOU’LL MAKE A DIFFERENCE**

  

* **Communication, Collaboration & Leadership** : Communicates status in daily meetings, fosters constructive, collaborative and effective communication with others, both internally and externally. Actively participates in design discussions, planning, and retrospective reviews. Explains and simplifies complex information to others.
* **Knowledge** : Ensures processes are clearly documented. Demonstrates a basic understanding of the functions and technologies of the product. Learns about multiple test techniques, tools and business context and technologies of the software used. Addresses problems, proposes solutions, and takes action to resolve, referring more complex issues to senior employees.
* **Metrics** : Creates and monitors status dashboards for tracking team progress
* **Quality Standards** : Drives analysis of post release quality and defect escapes and implements improvements based on the results of analysis. Completes straightforward projects and provides input for enhancements to improve test coverage and processes. Assesses the testability of components and features built by development teams. Works with project team to establish quality standards or metrics and identify risks.
* **Test Strategy & Planning** : Identifies salient test cases based on product domain knowledge and traceability to use cases, enabling on-time sprint deployments. Writes effective and efficient test scripts and test cases. Reviews of test plans are thoughtful and considerate of the customer and time frames needed for releases.
* **Test Execution** : Ensures thorough and complete resolution and closure of tickets once deployed to production. Assists developers in desk checks and testing. Works with the team to ensure code is tested at the appropriate level, assists in gaining efficiencies. Identifies and prevents defects early. Proactively works to identify the root cause of problems and identifies efficient ways to reproduce issues. Contributes to bug triage and prioritization processes.
* **Mentorship** : Provides peer level technical guidance for team members. Helps more junior team members learn, grow and contribute to the team.

**YOU ARE**

* **Genuinely curious — you ask why, not just whether.** You want to understand why a tag fires in a specific sequence, what the Liquid personalization token is supposed to render for a given profile, and what a consent mode change means downstream for pixel data. You treat every testability gap as a signal worth investigating, not an obstacle to work around.
* **Shift-left by default.** You don't wait for a build to find problems. You read acceptance criteria like an auditor — spotting what's missing, what's ambiguous, and what will create a defect if it isn't clarified before dev starts. Refinement is where your value shows up first.
* **A master of async defect communication.** You file bugs the way a distributed team needs you to — self-contained, structured, and immediately actionable. A QA defect in your queue is never a mystery that needs a Zoom call to decode. Your documentation is your reputation.
* **Globally minded** , with experience working on geographically distributed teams. You understand the discipline, cadence, and over-communication required to make a US–India collaboration genuinely cohesive — and you've built those habits in practice.
* **Methodical and detail-oriented** — you understand that a missed pixel fire or a broken personalization token has real downstream consequences for marketing measurement and campaign performance. You bring that care to every test case you write and every defect you file.
* **A collaborative teammate** , comfortable working across engineering, product, analytics, and marketing functions within a globally distributed model. You don't stay in a QA swim lane — you go where quality needs attention.

**YOU HAVE**

* Bachelor’s Degree required Computer Science, Information Systems or a related field. An equivalent combination of education and experience may be considered.
* 4+ years’ experience
* Proficiency with **Postman** for API testing — structured request/response validation, test data generation, role-based access checks, and SLA timing verification.
* Experience with **email QA** — template render testing using Email on Acid, Litmus, or equivalent; familiarity with ESP platform testing (Zeta, Braze, Emarsys, or similar).
* Working knowledge of **tag management QA** — understanding what tag management systems do, how to use browser developer tools to validate tag fires, and how to read data layer objects against a specification. Experience with the **Adobe Experience Platform Debugger** or equivalent tag debugging tooling is strongly preferred.
* Solid understanding of **agile/Scrum delivery** — shift-left quality practices, sprint ceremony participation, Definition of Ready and Definition of Done as quality gates, QA sizing in sprint planning.
* Experience with **Jira** for defect tracking, defect lifecycle management, and sprint ticket status workflows.
* Experience testing across a **multi-phase test lifecycle** : QA SIT UAT E2E Production validation.
* Demonstrated experience working on a **globally distributed or cross-timezone team** — including a US–India GCC model, offshore delivery, or equivalent. Prior experience collaborating with remote stakeholders is strongly preferred.
Strong written and verbal English communication skills — including the ability to write async-friendly defect reports, test status updates, and QA documentation that remote teammates can act on independently without a live call.  

**Nice to Have**

* Experience with **Adobe Analytics** validation — understanding how events, eVars, props, and conversion metrics are captured and how to confirm accuracy against a measurement plan (SDR).
* Familiarity with **OneTrust** or consent management platforms and how they gate tag firing (GDPR/CCPA context).
* Experience testing on **Salesforce Commerce Cloud (SFCC)** — navigating Business Manager for test data setup, order creation, and profile configuration.
* Knowledge of **CI/CD pipeline integration** for test automation — CircleCI, GitHub Actions, or equivalent; understanding of artifact reporting and suite segmentation (smoke, regression, integration).
* Exposure to **Liquid templating** in ESP platforms — ability to validate personalization logic and token rendering in email templates.
